en-US.author: Jens Roggenfelder
en-US.description: Cloud-free revival for Bose SoundTouch speakers. Unofficial community project, not affiliated with Bose.
en-US.longDescription:
ST Reborn (STR) brings internet radio, Spotify Connect, the hardware preset keys and multiroom back to Bose SoundTouch speakers after the Bose cloud shutdown. The desktop app installs a small agent onto the speaker over your home network and then controls every speaker running STR, with no Bose cloud and no account.
STR is an independent open source project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Bose Corporation. Bose and SoundTouch are registered trademarks of Bose Corporation.

en-US.releaseNotes:
STR v1.5.4
Built from commit: 360bab1686dc807b52c4dbcde11c53ce48c32a0a
Workflow run: https://github.com/JRpersonal/streborn/actions/runs/42520991588

What's changed in v1.5.4

New features
- A running speaker update is shown clearly on the speaker, so nobody presses the remote in the meantime (app)

Fixes
- A music library preset pressed on a sleeping speaker no longer shows the previous station buffering while it wakes (app)
- A preset key that failed to start no longer stays lit with its station name (app)
- Long titles are cut after two lines with "…" in the app and on the phone instead of stretching the track info (app)
- Restarting a speaker from the sign-in warning says it is still restarting instead of blaming the firewall (app)
- While switching stations only the new station shows "playing on" (app)
- The speaker's standby clock shows the right hour in time zones whose rules changed after the speaker's firmware was made, such as British Columbia's permanent UTC-7 (clock)
- The standby clock comes back if the display stays dark after the track text is cleared (display)
- The firmware stick holds only the Bose update file, so the speaker no longer skips it because of STR's install files next to it (firmware)
- The firmware update guide tells SoundTouch 20 and 30 owners to use the USB-A socket (SETUP B), not a micro-USB port with an OTG adapter (firmware)
- A music folder on a preset key keeps playing after the speaker is switched off and on again, instead of stopping after one song (library)
- Starting a music folder preset from the app keeps the repeat setting (library)
- A preset started right after forming a stereo pair keeps playing instead of being stopped by STR a few seconds later (multiroom)
- The stereo pair's name button reads "Rename" and confirms when the new name is saved (multiroom)
- A Pandora preset that the speaker cannot start says so instead of "Speaker refused" (pandora)
- STR no longer restarts the previous track after a Pandora preset the speaker could not start (pandora)
- The Pandora button stays visible with a hint while the speaker's Pandora is unavailable (pandora)
- "Update all" on the phone stops after a Wi-Fi outage of about a quarter hour, like a single speaker update (phone)
- The phone remote's mute button follows a mute set in the app or with the Bose remote (phone)
- A station without its own logo shows its letter tile instead of an unrelated icon from its stream host (radio)
- Searching "Gold 90.5" finds the station listed as "Gold 905", also when other stations carry the word as a tag (radio)
- A speaker whose firmware is too old goes straight to the firmware update instead of getting STR files on the stick first (setup)
- If sending the Spotify engine to a speaker breaks off after an update, the app tries again instead of leaving the speaker without Spotify (update)
- Forming and dissolving groups and stereo pairs no longer leaves a speaker at volume 0 (volume)
- Pressing a preset on a speaker in standby keeps your volume instead of jumping to the start volume a second later (volume)

Verify your download
Every binary in this release is attested by GitHub's build provenance system.
# SHA256 checksum
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
# Sigstore attestation (requires GitHub CLI)
gh attestation verify STR-Windows.exe --owner JRpersonal

Code signing
Windows: signed with a Certum Open Source code signing certificate. SmartScreen may still warn while the signature builds download reputation.
macOS: signed with a Developer ID certificate and notarized by Apple. The app and the disk image each carry a stapled ticket, so Gatekeeper opens them without a warning, offline included.
Any warning you do see, and the exact click path past it, is documented on the website Verify page.

VirusTotal scan
